MECHANISM: Width-for-time Pareto continuation

HYPOTHESIS: An 85-unit GRU processing 27 endpoint-preserving frames will achieve at least 85% validation accuracy while reducing recurrent MACs by approximately 1.5% versus the verified 84-unit, 28-step model.

INTENDED_EDIT: Increase the GRU and dual-timescale readout width from 84 to 85 while reducing the causal schedule from 28 to 27 frames.

EVIDENCE: The consecutive diagonal designs from 81 units/31 steps through 84 units/28 steps all passed; the current 84-unit, 28-step model achieved 85.64% accuracy, supporting one more incremental width-for-time trade.
